subject: Literature
title: Afrofuturism in Literature
description: A fast breakdown of Afrofuturism in Literature for builders.

hook.text: Octavia Butler imagined futures where Black people were not just present but central to shaping humanity's fate.

buildup.text: Afrofuturism blended science fiction, African mythology, and Black history into new literary worlds.

discovery.text: Butler's Kindred and Parable of the Sower explored race, power, and survival through speculative fiction.

twist.text: For decades, publishers told Butler that Black readers did not buy science fiction. She proved them wrong.

climax.text: Afrofuturism expanded what speculative fiction could be, inspiring literature, music, and film globally.

punchline.text: The future finally looked like all of humanity.

quiz.question: What obstacle did Octavia Butler face?
options: She could not find a writing mentor
Publishers told her Black readers did not buy science fiction
She was unable to complete any novels
